_purpose: Evidence genealogy for the lost-books witnesses. AGREEMENT IS NOT INDEPENDENCE: most of the derivative tradition descends from Livy himself or from shared intermediaries, so four witnesses telling the same story may be one tradition wearing four costumes. Every cross-witness corroboration claim must consult this file before counting attestations.

depends_on.note: summaries of Livy, possibly via an intermediate epitome rather than the full text (scholarly debate); NOT independent of Livy by definition
independent OF THE PERIOCHAE (different epitome tradition) but not of Livy; divergences between the two epitomes are evidence about the common source
prodigy excerpts drawn from Livy's annual prodigy lists, possibly via an epitome; year-structure preserves Livy's annalistic skeleton
'Epitome de Tito Livio' by transmitted title, but Florus is rhetorical and uses non-Livian material too; treat each parallel as probable-dependence, not quotation
breviarium tradition; likely mediated through earlier epitomes (the so-called Epitome/Livian tradition), not direct use of 142 books
Eutropius, Festus, and the De viris illustribus share material — a common intermediary ('Enmannsche Kaisergeschichte'-style) is suspected for parts
Orosius demonstrably used Florus in places

orosius.warning: Orosius agreeing with Florus is usually ONE vote, not two

depends_on.note: Plutarch cites Livy by name in several Lives, but draws equally on Pollio, Sallust, memoirs, and Greek sources

plutarch.independence: PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT — the most valuable property in this witness set: Plutarch-vs-Periochae agreement can constitute real double attestation, unlike Florus-vs-Periochae

depends_on.note: Dio worked from the broad annalistic tradition incl. Livy, but his late-republican narrative has clear non-Livian strands

cassius-dio.independence: PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT, same caveat as Plutarch; mediated by Zonaras/excerptors for the fragmentary ranges

depends_on.note: explicit 'T. LIVI' attributions with verbatim quotation — the gold standard; the only dependence question is Seneca's own quotation accuracy
physical copy of the text itself; no intermediary author

counting_rule: For any event, attestation count = number of substantially-independent lineages, not number of witnesses. Default lineages: (1) Livy-derivative lineage [periochae + oxyrhynchus + obsequens + florus + eutropius + orosius — count as ONE unless witnesses diverge in substance], (2) Plutarch lineage, (3) Dio lineage, (4) direct transmission [palimpsest, quotations]. Divergence BETWEEN Livy-derivative witnesses is itself evidence (about the shared source or about contamination), and should be recorded, not averaged away.
iteration_rule: Review passes may DOWNGRADE a relationship status, MERGE witnesses into one lineage, or REJECT a proposed parallel. The scaffold must never only accumulate.
